title: Which video for which product?
intro: Give each product its type. Pilotix shows you the video formats that work best for it.

typeHelp.2: Competitors sell a similar product, not the same.
typeHelp.3: Competitors sell exactly the same one.

why.1: Your product is new: people must understand it. Show it, explain it.
why.2: People compare: prove yours is better.
why.3: The product is the same everywhere: make them choose your shop (trust, offer, speed).

noProducts: Add products in Products & stock first.
chooseFirst: Choose the product's type: the recommended formats show here.

circle.name: Life ad circle
circle.why1: Each product gets a small budget before it gets a big one.
circle.why2: The rules are written down: the whole team decides the same way.
circle.why3: An ad is switched off only when we are sure. A product that wins gets more.
circle.tap: Tap a round to read its rules and change its settings.
circle.ringLabel: The five steps of the circle
circle.note: Pilotix keeps these rules and your settings here. It does not launch or judge any ad by itself yet.
circle.noSettings: No setting here for this step: all its numbers come from Pilot Checks.
circle.from: Underlined numbers come from Pilot Checks: change them there, and they change here by themselves.
circle.fromOther: Underlined numbers come from Pilot Checks: the administrator sets them.
circle.warnAds: Your test has {{have}}, but Pilot Checks allows {{max}} at most. Take out a video or an image.
circle.tooManyAds: A test has {{max}} at most (videos + images). This number is set in Pilot Checks.
circle.noAds: A test has at least one ad: a video or an image.
circle.badNumber: Type a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

help.test: Each new product gets a small budget to see if people like it.
help.judge: When the test ends, each ad gets its verdict.
help.scale: Winning ads enter the SCALE campaign: this is where more budget goes.
help.watch: Every day, we look at what a confirmed order costs.
help.again: The round starts again: new products, new videos.

r.bidLimit: Each product has its bid limit: what a confirmed order may cost in ads. It is worked out from the product’s margin.
r.noMargin: A product with no margin, or with under {{stockStop}} of stock, is not launched: its test waits.
r.launch: Tests start on {{testDay}}: one ad set per product, with {{testVideos}} and {{testImages}}. Never more than {{testAds}} in a test.
r.launchVideos: Tests start on {{testDay}}: one ad set per product, with {{testVideos}}. Never more than {{testAds}} in a test.
r.launchImages: Tests start on {{testDay}}: one ad set per product, with {{testImages}}. Never more than {{testAds}} in a test.
r.testCap: No bid cap during the test: Meta spends freely. Audience: all of Algeria, no interests, no age limit.
r.testBudget: Budget of a test: {{testBuys}} times the product’s bid limit, for {{testDays}}. It is for the whole test, not per day.
r.handsOff: During the test, nothing is touched: not the budget, not the ads. No ad is judged in its first {{judgeDays}}. After that, an ad is switched off only when it is proven to cost too much.
r.handsOffNow: During the test, nothing is touched: not the budget, not the ads. An ad is switched off only when it is proven to cost too much.
r.adId: Each ad carries its ad tag (ad ID). Without it, the ad is not launched.
r.verdict: The verdict comes on the first {{judgeDay}} after the test ends. Each ad gets its own: we count its confirmed orders.
r.winner: Winner: {{winOrders}} or more, at a cost equal to the bid limit or under it.
r.notWinner: Not a winner: only when it is proven, with under a {{proofPct}} chance that it is bad luck. The ad is switched off.
r.undecided: Neither: one retest only, in the test of the next {{testDay}}. The second verdict is final.
r.pending: If orders not called yet could change the verdict, we wait for their answer: {{pendingHours}} at most.
r.after: After the verdict, the test ad set is switched off. Winning ads enter SCALE.
r.batch: Winning ads enter SCALE once a week, all together: on verdict day, {{judgeDay}}.
r.keep: Each winning ad enters with its post: its comments and likes stay.
r.group: SCALE has a bid cap. A winning ad starts in an ad set shared with products whose bid limits are close: a gap of {{groupBand}} at most. The ad set’s bid cap is its lowest bid limit.
r.own: At {{ownOrders}} a week or more, the product gets its own ad set.
r.startBudget: Starting budget: {{budgetBase}} for each product in the ad set, in the ad account’s currency.
r.lines: We compare the cost of a confirmed order with the bid limit. Good: {{good}} times the bid limit or less. Bad: over {{bad}} times. Stop: over {{stop}} times.
r.budgetWait: A budget moves only with enough data: {{budgetWait}} at least.
r.budgetUp: Good, and the budget is almost all spent: the budget goes up by {{budgetStep}}. Between good and bad: nothing moves.
r.budgetDown: Bad: the budget goes down by {{budgetStep}}, {{budgetCuts}} in a row at most, never under {{budgetBase}} per product. After that, above the stop line, the worst ad of the ad set is switched off.
r.proof: No ad is judged in its first {{judgeDays}}. After that, it is switched off only when we are sure: under a {{proofPct}} chance that it is bad luck. Few orders: we wait.
r.proofNow: An ad is switched off only when we are sure: under a {{proofPct}} chance that it is bad luck. Few orders: we wait.
r.stock: Stock always wins. Under {{stockStop}} of stock: no new spend on the product. At 0 pieces: its ads are switched off. A product with no margin is paused.
r.freeze: {{freezeEdits}} or more in 7 days on one ad set means a freeze: no edit for {{freezeDays}}. Stops stay allowed.
r.brake: Account brake: if your SCALE ads cost over {{brakeAt}} times what their bid limits allow, {{brakeDays}} in a row, no new product enters the test.
r.noData: When data is missing, no budget goes up.
r.round: Every week, the round starts again with new products.
r.roundN: Every week, the round starts again with {{testPerWeek}}.
r.videoDay: The videos of the next test are ready on {{againVideoDay}}.
r.newIdea: While fewer than {{ideasMin}} are live, one truly new video idea is added in each test: only one, for a product that already wins.
r.copy: A live ad is never edited. To fix a video, we make a copy, tested in the test of the next {{testDay}}.
r.lost: A lost product gets no ad until the manager brings it back as a new test.
r.messages: Exception: a lost product that still got some orders moves to a message ad, at a lower price, with the AI answering.
r.always: Awareness and catalogue ads always run, with their own budget, outside the KPIs.
r.alwaysBudget: Awareness and catalogue ads always run, with their own budget: {{awarenessBudget}}.
r.noRule: When no rule decides, nothing is done on that ad: the manager decides, and the decision becomes a new rule.

f.againMessages: Lost product with some orders: message ad
f.againAlways: Awareness and catalogue ads always on

h.testPerWeek: How many new products enter the test each week.
h.testVideos: Really different videos, not the same one twice.
h.testBuys: Test budget = this number × the product’s bid limit, over the whole test.
h.testDays: The budget is for this whole length, not per day.
h.judgeDay: The day tests are judged. Winning ads enter SCALE that day.
h.againVideoDay: The day all the videos of the next test must be finished.
h.againMessages: At a lower price, with the AI answering.
h.againAlways: They run during the whole circle.
